ShortDescription.Value: Fix too many Not Enough Customers icons by balancing shop production and shopping demand.

Publish.LongDescription:
# 🛒 ## Tired of "Not Enough Customers" (NEC) icons everywhere?
Got a city covered in NEC icons? Give this a try!
In a 90k city, **335 NEC warnings dropped to just 20 after ~5 minutes.** No bulldozing hundreds of shops!
### Why does this happen?
Ironically, **"Not Enough Customers" doesn't count customers!**
* Normal shops get NEC when **over 90% of their Service is sitting unused**. * Shop workers are paid to make Service. It's separate from the goods delivered to the store (food, beverages, etc.). * Vanilla already slows Service production when shops get too full, but not enough and too late. * This explodes at peak times when lots of cims are at work or school and fewer can shop. Cims are not allowed to shop while at work/school.
Even adding more citizens doesn't always solve it.
### What this mod does
* **Starts helping at ~82% unused Service**, before NEC icons appear. * **Slows Service production harder** when shops can't sell it fast enough. Backs off when they recover. * **Helps balance shopping demand** using real households, not fake shoppers. * **Separately helps Leisure** (Meals, Entertainment, Recreation). * **Best-effort help for hotels**, using existing tourists. It won't invent thousands of fake guests. * Safe to remove anything. No Harmony patches. Works with the game's existing systems.
### Test results
* **130k city:** 165 NEC → 4 after ~20 min. * **95k city:** 335 NEC → 20 after 5 min, 6 after ~20 min.
### What to expect
* Give it a little time; NEC icons can sit at the same number for a while as the city rebalances. * If you have only 10–20 after ~30 min, now is a good time prune a few shops. They don't have to be the exact ones showing NEC, but some of the remainder might have path issues making it harder for cims to get to them. * This helps realistically balance your city with the citizens you have, but doesn't fix every case of genuinely excess commercial capacity.
### Support and Feedback
* If this helps your city, click the **LIKE 👍** button! No donations needed. * Feedback is welcome on Discord, and PRs are welcome on GitHub.
